page.notes: Hebrew forms are transcribed by eye from a low-resolution scan with show-through and light speckle, so most Hebrew vocalisation and consonants are approximate and should be checked against the original; they are not marked individually with [?]. The faint ghosted text in the lower left of the left column and the mirrored marks in the centre are show-through, not printed text, and were left out. The top-left page number and running head are uncertain; the page number may be 300 and the right-hand one 301. The word "volavit" and the letter heading "p" are read tentatively.
